title: Traverse two bounded child pages without duplicates
preconditions: Use newServiceFixture with exactly two distinct children under urn:change-saga:query-test:saga; keep the snapshot unchanged.

steps.action: Read children of the Saga with limit 1.
steps.expected_result: total=2, returned=1, has_more=true, and next_cursor is non-null.

steps.action: Read the same children using the returned cursor and limit 1.
steps.expected_result: total=2, returned=1, has_more=false, next_cursor=null, and the child identity differs from page one; returned totals sum to 2.

expected_result: All two matching records are returned exactly once with coherent terminal metadata.
